title: Q-CIFAIL-ultrastable-uiux: uiux is failing in ultrastable/ultrastable
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every executor run and every ciwatch run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ciwatch --probe ultrastable/ultrastable uiux
**Status:** closed

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T16:02:09Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-25T16:44:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-26T11:52:08Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: exit 0
